scope: Six compound development queries authored with source and retrieval code visible; references reused from the older golden set. Not independent or held-out. Reference presence is not factual endorsement.

questions.q: Our 3000-page store still has old robots-blocked URLs in Google. What should we fix first and is crawl budget the problem?

references.quote: If the site has fewer than about 10,000 pages, ignore crawl budget
They can stay indexed as bare URLs.
Score each issue on four things, 1 to 3 each

questions.q: Build a welcome flow and tell me how to assess it when opens rise but clicks stay flat; what sender authentication alignment should I check?

references.quote: If opens jump but clicks do not, assume privacy features, not interest
Welcome (4 to 5 emails over about 10 to 14 days)
the SPF or DKIM domain matches the domain in the visible From address

questions.q: Retargeting ROAS looks great but pausing it did not change sales. Should I double budgets, change audiences and judge a new creative after two days?

references.quote: make moderate steps and batch other edits together
Warm ad sets show high ROAS but total sales do not move when they pause
Minimum length: 7 days, to cover weekday patterns

questions.q: Orders are shipping late and data requests sit in the ticket queue. Which standard replies should we avoid and what must we handle first?

references.quote: tell the customer before they ask and offer the choice to cancel
Data requests left in the general queue
do not use if the order is more than 10 days late

questions.q: Audit checkout payment handling: we mark paid on the success page and retry both invalid requests and timed-out charges. What is unsafe?

references.quote: do not retry it, because it will fail the same way; fix the request
the order is marked paid on the success page, not by the webhook
The outside call times out but actually succeeded

questions.q: Our team edits the live homepage daily and overlapping apps slow it down. Plan theme-copy work and prioritize speed fixes by business value.

references.quote: agree a time to copy any content changes made on the live theme
several apps doing overlapping jobs (two review widgets, three pop-ups)
Payback is sales at risk divided by effort
